Chachamaru and I sat on a heap of rubble.

A very short time ago, this place had been called Fudaraku Castle's keep.
Not a trace remained. We had not done that. The enemy general's tremendous strength had.

en.html:
Twilight covered the world.

Silver stars danced like fireflies.
But the one that should have shone brightest was not among them.

The forged thunder bomb had already been dropped. The Silver Star had vanished with it.

I did not know what had happened to Hikaru.

ja.html:
夕闇が世界を覆っている。

　銀色の星が幾つも、蛍のように舞っていた。
　しかし、最も強い輝きを放つ筈の者はそこにいない。

　既に鍛造雷弾は落とされ、銀星号はそれと共に姿を
消している。

　光がどうなったのか、俺にはわからなかった。

en.html:
I had just said I would never believe her again.
I made no answer.

Only inside, I nodded.

We passed the time in silence.
The moment called catastrophe flowed gently on.

The world would end now, probably.
Yet everything around us was simply quiet… as though the end had already come.

No sound. Only light and darkness shifting.

ja.html:
二度と信じないと言った矢先だ。
　俺は何も答えなかった。

　胸の内でだけ、頷いておいた。

　黙って時を過ごす。
　破局という瞬間が穏やかに流れてゆく。

　世界はこれから終わるのだろう。
　しかし辺りは、既に終わりを迎えたかのように……
ただ静かであった。

　音はなく、光と闇だけが移ろっている。

Kageaki"…"

Kageaki"Say it."
Chachamaru"Yeah. Actually…"

Kageaki"…"
Chachamaru"From the first time I heard your voice. …Did you know?"
Kageaki"…"
Chachamaru"…"
Kageaki"I see."
Chachamaru"Yeah."
